name: cRZSerializableStream::Construct (ret 4: base stream constructors inlined, game vtables, empty buffer, byte order)
notes: Hooked, not run in-game. The two base constructors (0x1b4f75, 0x1b4d82, unverified) are written inline: they only clear the count and owner and store the order byte. Test: 3000 seeds with random garbage objects and orders; whole 0x38 bytes incl. vtables compared. Mutants killed: input count 1, SetByteOrder call dropped survived (equivalent: the base constructors already set both order bytes).

name: cRZSerializableStream::Destruct
notes: Hooked, not run in-game. Reset, then the input base (vtable 0xda2a20, release the owner at +0x1c), then the output base (vtable 0xda29bc, release the owner at +0xc); the owner fakes record the object's vtables at release time. Test: 3000 seeds, owners present or null. Mutants killed: input owner release dropped, Reset dropped, vtable store after the output release. The returned eax (owner Release result) is not compared.

name: cRZSerializableStream::`scalar deleting destructor' (slot 21, ret 4)
notes: Hooked, not run in-game. Destruct, then sized delete of 0x38 bytes when bit 0 is set; returns this. Test: flags 0, 1, 2, 0xfffffffd on 3000 seeds, object freed or compared. Mutant killed: flag bit 2 tested instead of bit 0.

name: cRZSerializableStream::vf16_21 (cRZIStream subobject thunk: this - 0x10, then slot 21's function)
notes: Hooked, not run in-game. Tested with this = primary + 0x10 on the same 3000 seeds as the deleting destructor.

name: cRZSerializableStream::QueryInterface (slot 0, ret 8)
notes: Hooked, not run in-game. Ids 0x853d26de and 0xe4fda3d4 give this + 0x20 and AddRef through slot 1 of the primary vtable; others try cRZOStream then cRZIStream (this + 0x10) QueryInterface, whose AddRef goes through the input vtable's slot 1. Test: 18000 cases over the three entry points, ids at the edges and random; al, out pointer, recorded AddRefs (with the subobject offset) compared. Mutants killed: extra id 1, AddRef dropped.

name: cRZSerializableStream::Release (slot 2: jmp to the shared stream release 0x1b5fc4)
notes: NOT hooked (5-byte jmp thunk; the shared body 0x1b5fc4 serves other classes). The member implements the shared body: count above 1 is decremented and returned, otherwise slot 21 is called with 1 and 0 returned. Test: 9000 cases with counts 0, 1, 2, 3, 0xffffffff, 0x80000000 and random, through the three entry points; full eax and the recorded delete call compared. Mutants killed: threshold 2, deleting flags 0.

name: cRZSerializableStream::SetVoid (slot 17, ret 8: append bytes)
notes: Hooked, not run in-game. Null source or zero count skip the copy; otherwise Grow(n) (result ignored: ORIGINAL-BUG if the allocation could fail, unreachable as operator new[] throws) then copy to data + size; returns !GetError (slot 18), al only. Test: 3000 seeds, counts around the free space, null sources; size, capacity, buffer bytes and recorded GetError compared. Mutants killed: Grow dropped, result forced true, zero count not skipped. Allocation failure is not tested.

name: cRZSerializableStream::SetByteOrder (slot 22, ret 4)
notes: Hooked, not run in-game. While data is null, stores the low byte of the argument at +8 and +0x18; returns al = 1. Test: 9000 cases over the three entry points (0x9cbe12 and 0x9cbe1a thunks too). Mutants killed: condition on size instead of data, input byte not stored.

name: cRZSerializableStream::Remaining (size - position, unsigned)
notes: Hooked, not run in-game. Test: 3000 seeds including positions past the size, plus the wrap-around extremes.

name: cRZSerializableStream::Reserve (ret 4: buffer of exactly n bytes when capacity is smaller)
notes: Hooked, not run in-game. New zeroed buffer, first size bytes copied, old one freed with delete[]. Test: 3000 seeds with n around the capacity. Mutants killed: <= instead of <, copy of capacity bytes instead of size. Allocation failure (returns false, buffer unchanged) is not tested.

name: cRZSerializableStream::Grow (ret 4: capacity + n + 0x80 when the free space is not above n)
notes: Hooked, not run in-game. Test: 3000 seeds with n around the free space. Mutants killed: strict compare, 0x7f instead of 0x80 in the allocation and in the capacity. Allocation failure is not tested.

name: cRZSerializableStream::Skip (cRZIStream slot 3, ret 4)
notes: Hooked, not run in-game. Enough bytes left: position advanced and SetError(0); else SetError(1); returns !GetError (al only). Test: 3000 seeds incl. positions past the size. Mutant killed: strict compare.

name: cRZSerializableStream::GetVoid (cRZIStream slot 17, ret 8)
notes: Hooked, not run in-game. Copy from data + position when n bytes remain, then SetError(0/1) and !GetError. Test: 3000 seeds, destination bytes compared (canary filled). Mutants killed: position not advanced; the strict-compare mutant shared with Skip.

name: cRZSerializableStream::Write (cIGZSerializableStream slot 3, ret 4)
notes: Hooked, not run in-game. Size via the output stream's slot 9 then the bytes via slot 17, size and data tested again between; a zero size via slot 9 without data. The fake slot 9 sometimes clears the size or hides the data. Test: 3000 seeds incl. size without data. Mutants killed: recheck dropped (both halves), zero-size write dropped.

name: cRZSerializableStream::Read (cIGZSerializableStream slot 4, ret 4)
notes: Hooked, not run in-game. Size via the input stream's slot 9 (left 0 when the getter writes nothing), Reserve, bytes via slot 17, size stored. Test: 3000 seeds incl. sizes around the capacity and a failing size getter. Mutants killed: size not stored, Reserve skipped for small sizes. The Reserve-failure branch (SetError(1)) is not tested: the allocation cannot fail in the harness.
